docs.hours.md: The clinic is open Sunday to Thursday from 9 am to 8 pm, and Saturday from 10 am to 4 pm. It is closed on Fridays.
docs.doctors.md: Dr. Salma Hassan is the dermatologist, and sees patients on Sundays and Tuesdays. Dr. Omar Nabil is the pediatrician, and sees patients on every working day except Wednesday.
docs.prices.md: A first consultation costs 400 EGP and a follow-up within two weeks costs 150 EGP. Blood tests start at 250 EGP.
docs.booking.md: Appointments are booked by phone at 02-5550-123 or through the app. Cancel at least 6 hours ahead to get a full refund.
docs.insurance.md: The clinic accepts Allianz and AXA insurance. Insured patients pay 20% of the consultation fee.
docs.location.md: The clinic is on the second floor of 12 Tahrir Street, in Dokki. Parking is available behind the building.
docs.results.md: Blood test results are ready within 24 hours and are sent by email.

docs.plans.md: The Basic plan costs 150 EGP a month and includes 10 GB and 500 minutes. The Plus plan costs 250 EGP a month and includes 40 GB and 1,500 minutes. The Max plan costs 400 EGP a month and includes unlimited data and 3,000 minutes.
docs.extra.md: Extra data costs 20 EGP per GB. Minutes over the plan cost 0.5 EGP each.
docs.roaming.md: Roaming works in 40 countries, including Saudi Arabia and the UAE, at 30 EGP a day.
docs.router.md: The home router costs 900 EGP, or 100 EGP a month for 12 months. It supports Wi-Fi 6.
docs.switch.md: You can move to a bigger plan at any time; moving to a smaller plan takes effect at the next billing date. Plans have no contract.
docs.support.md: Customer support is on 19999, every day from 8 am to midnight. Technicians visit within 48 hours.
docs.new.md: New customers get 50% off the first month on any plan.

bank.prompt: You are a customer service agent for a bank.
bank.answer: Answer in one or two sentences, using only the given context.

docs.account.md: The Everyday account has no monthly fee if the balance stays above 5,000 EGP; otherwise the fee is 30 EGP a month.
docs.savings.md: The Savings account pays 18% a year, paid monthly. The minimum deposit is 10,000 EGP.
docs.certificate.md: The 3-year certificate pays 22% a year. It can be cashed early after 6 months with a 2% penalty.
docs.card.md: The debit card is free for the first year, then costs 150 EGP a year. Withdrawals from other banks' ATMs cost 10 EGP.
docs.transfer.md: Transfers through the app are free up to 50,000 EGP a day. Transfers above that need a visit to a branch.
docs.branch.md: Branches are open Sunday to Thursday from 8:30 am to 3 pm. The Zamalek branch is also open on Saturdays until 1 pm.
docs.open.md: To open an account you need a national ID and a recent utility bill. Foreign residents also need a valid passport.

docs.المكان.md: المركز في مدينة نصر، شارع عباس العقاد. وفيه كورسات أونلاين بنفس السعر.
docs.الشهادة.md: كل اللي يخلص الكورس ويحضر 80% من المحاضرات بياخد شهادة.
